u0: Idle/steady shop state: no urgent siren duty, no pot emergency, nothing held, no order taken and no fallen food. Scan for the next trigger: if the siren rings (and the pot is not boiling, hands empty) go silence it; if the pot boils and hands are empty go to the stove; if a client is waiting, take the order; if food has slipped, retrieve it. Otherwise keep patrolling the shop to be near the counter, pantry and stove.
u1: Siren-silencing subtask: the siren is ringing and the agent is not carrying food. Head for the siren switch and toggle it (reward on the switch_toggled transition). If the pot starts boiling first, switch to handling the pot while holding nothing; if a slip or a client arrival intervenes, react accordingly.
u2: Pot-only subtask: the pot is boiling over and the agent has empty hands. Walk to the stove and toggle it to turn it down, since the stove only goes down with empty hands. If the siren starts ringing, handle the louder siren first; if a client arrives, take the order; keep the pot as the pending chore until fixed.
u3: Recovery subtask after a slip: food has fallen and the agent's hands are empty. The food lies on an adjacent cell and the agent already faces it, so pick it up on the very next move. Once holding food, return to the idle state and resume whatever duty was pending.
u4: Order-served workflow in progress: a client's order has been taken. Fetch raw food from the pantry, then carry it to the stove and prepare it while the client waits (food_prepared moves toward serving). Keep reacting to interim events: turn the siren off if it rings, and handle the pot if it boils (needs hands-free, so manage the carried food).
u5: Pot-boiling while carrying food: the stove can only be turned down with empty hands, so reach a free cell next to the stove, drop the carried item in front, toggle the stove to turn it down, then pick the item back up. Keep an eye on the siren; if it rings, prioritize silencing it while still managing the held food.
u6: Both siren and pot active while the agent holds food: the siren is ringing and the pot is boiling, but the hands are occupied. First turn the siren off (it can be toggled while carrying), then return to the pot-boiling duty, where the food must be put down to fix the stove; also handle a client arrival if one appears.
u7: Client-waiting subtask with a pot/priority context: a client is present at the counter and the order has not yet been taken. Face the client and toggle to take the order. If the siren rings, silence it first; if the pot is boiling and hands are empty, address the stove first (or hold until the order is safely taken).
u8: Serving subtask: the agent is carrying prepared (green) food and a client with a taken order waits. Go to the client, face them and toggle to serve—this yields the full serve reward. If the pot boils, deal with the stove by putting the food down first; if the siren rings, silence it; if the food slips, recover it.
